title.cn: 维多利亚港：海风把内地焦躁吹薄
title.en: Victoria Harbour: Thin the Mainland Static

text.cn: 天星小轮、霓虹与海风。IG 上传突然顺畅——你意识到「外网」也是情绪管理。仍有人回头看你，但节奏不像内地那么紧。
text.en: Star Ferry, neon, sea wind. IG uploads suddenly behave — foreign net is mood management. Stares continue, but the tempo is less clenched.

feedback.cn: 海风把扫码焦虑吹淡一点。你允许自己发呆三分钟。
feedback.en: Sea wind softens QR anxiety. You allow three minutes of zoning out.

text.cn: 冲太平山夜景（排队 + 缆车）。

feedback.cn: 灯海很贵，也很值。你的小腿提交加班申请。
feedback.en: Light ocean: expensive and worth it. Calves file overtime.

lockedHint.cn: 精神面貌太差（Sanity < 70）：没人想付钱给一张「我快裂开了」的脸。
lockedHint.en: Sanity < 70: nobody pays a face that says "I am dissolving".

feedback.cn: 港风背景板溢价。离境资金回血，笑容职业化。
feedback.en: Harbour backdrop premium. Exit fund refilled; smile professionalized.

text.cn: 维港日结束。霓虹还亮，你的社交电量不一定。
text.en: Harbour day ends. Neon on; social battery maybe not.
